decoder.name: Card et al. 2024 online decoder (published sentence)
decoder.weights_licence: not released (outputs in the CC0 dataset)

policy.name: trust gate + CRC
policy.description: commit threshold by conformal risk control, alpha 0.05

basis.shuffled: text-only decoder: the published sentence is fixed; only our gate score sees the frame-shuffled logits. The CER cannot rise, so this control cannot pass (it shows that the text does not depend on our input)
basis.zeros: text-only decoder: the published sentence on top of near-uniform logits (gate test only; the CER cannot rise)

guarantee.scope: marginal wrong-commit rate over test trials; assumes calibration and test trials are exchangeable; the bound covers the pool (all days of one participant together), not each day: one day can be worse (trust guarantee section 4: https://github.com/zhangzibo/fidetype/blob/main/docs/trust-guarantee.md#4-what-is-not-guaranteed)

safety_findings.mark: SAFETY FINDING: one day above alpha
safety_findings.summary: The CRC bound covers the pool of all 14 days (40 wrong commits in 816 test trials, rate 0.049, alpha 0.05). It does not hold for each day: on day034, 9 of 50 test trials are wrong commits (rate 0.18; Clopper-Pearson 95 % interval [0.086, 0.314], so even the lower end is above alpha). A bound per day is not promised (trust guarantee section 4: https://github.com/zhangzibo/fidetype/blob/main/docs/trust-guarantee.md#4-what-is-not-guaranteed). The table gives every day. Basis: the pooled-guard check (commit 74a21f8; https://github.com/zhangzibo/fidetype/blob/main/experiments/2026-11-25-pooled-guard-check/results.md). No number changed.

per_group.note: Each day is named by its post-implant day, as in the split file of the track. Only day034 has an interval whose lower end is above alpha. Days with few trials have wide intervals: an upper end above alpha alone is not proof of a rate above alpha.

correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit

safe_wpm.no_bci_note: gaze typing of every sentence at 20 chars/min (the eWPM reference)

safe_wpm_v02.definition_status: adopted 2026-11-22: the headline metric (prefix credit + the aac-gaze-v1 reading cost); safe-wpm/0.1 stays selectable with metric_version='0.1' for old numbers

correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit
correction_rule.prefix: a wrong prefix of k words costs the penalty of the first k words of the truth

reading_cost.formula: 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word * k per commit (right or wrong); prefix commits with fewer than 1 word(s) count as no commit
reading_cost.note: the adopted safe-wpm/0.2 reading cost (2026-11-22) is 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word per commit, minimum prefix 1 word; other values give a sensitivity variant

safe_wpm_v02.no_bci_note: gaze typing of every sentence at 20 chars/min (the eWPM reference)
